title: 2 Candidates Apply For the Job. Who Gets Picked? ⚖️
description:
2 Candidates Apply For the Job. Who Gets Picked? 

Candidate A might believe they’re a stronger candidate, but Candidate B approached their resume with strategy. That’s why Candidate B got the job.

Companies are looking for workers who will add value to the business. Candidate B describes very specific achievements that clearly show how they can add value.

When writing your work experience bullets, include specific numbers and achievements wherever possible.

Read through the job description and any online information about the company so you can include the keywords they are looking for and organize your resume to emphasize what’s most important to this specific company and role.

Want a resume that makes you look like a strong candidate? Follow to learn everything you need to know to get more interviews and offers!
